pattern: SELECT [A-Za-z]+, Rating FROM TV_[A-Za-z0-9]+ INNER JOIN TV_[A-Za-z0-9]+ ON TV_[A-Za-z0-9]+.\w+ = TV_[A-Za-z0-9]+\.id ORDER BY Rating
correction: SELECT [A-Za-z]+ FROM TV_[A-Za-z0-9]+ ORDER BY rating

metadata.description: This rule identifies and corrects SQL queries that unnecessarily join tables, which can lead to incorrect results or an empty result set.
